input: Any commit that modifies /moves/knight_b8.text must be co-signed by at least fourteen of the sixteen Black agents' keys in addition to the moving piece's own key, and any commit that modifies any /moves/<agent>.text path must also modify /turn/ply.num, so that agents who repeatedly go off plan (queen_d8, pawn_b7, pawn_d7, knight_b8) cannot push through a move without near-unanimous team agreement.
response: always([+modifies(/moves/knight_b8.text) -threshold("14", /team/pieces)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/knight_b8.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/knight_b8.id)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/$k.text) -modifies(/turn/ply.num)] false)
